title: Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning: Towards Robust CIL under Variable Class Arrivals
abstract: arXiv:2604.02765v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Class-incremental learning (CIL) is commonly evaluated under predefined schedules with fixed or nearly equal class increments, leaving irregular class-arrival scenarios underexplored. However, practical CIL systems may need to update whenever new categories emerge, without forcing them into balanced task partitions. We formalize this setting as Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning (FFCIL), where the number of newly arriving classes can vary substantially across learning stages. We show that variable class arrivals alter the class composition of incremental training, the reliability of new-class classifier statistics, and the consistency of representations learned across increments, causing clear performance degradation in both conventional and pre-trained model (PTM)-based CIL methods. To improve robustness under FFCIL, we introduce a general framework consisting of Class-Wise Mean (CWM), which replaces instance-wise loss aggregation

translated_title: 自由流类增量学习：面向可变类到达的鲁棒CIL方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.02765v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：类增量学习（CIL）通常在预定义的时间表下进行评估，这些时间表具有固定或近乎相等的类增量，导致不规则的类到达场景未被充分探索。然而，实际的CIL系统可能需要在出现新类别时随时更新，而无需将其强制划分为平衡的任务分区。我们将这种设置形式化为自由流类增量学习（FFCIL），其中新到达类别的数量在不同学习阶段可能显著变化。我们表明，可变类到达会改变增量训练中的类组成、新类分类器统计的可靠性以及跨增量学习表示的一致性，导致传统和基于预训练模型（PTM）的CIL方法性能明显下降。为了提高FFCIL下的鲁棒性，我们引入了一个通用框架，包括类级均值（CWM），它替代了实例级损失聚合。
tldr: 本文提出了自由流类增量学习（FFCIL）框架，通过类级均值（CWM）替代实例级损失聚合，有效应对类到达数量变化带来的性能退化，增强了CIL在非平衡场景下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning (FFCIL) framework, which uses Class-Wise Mean (CWM) to replace instance-wise loss aggregation, effectively mitigating performance degradation caused by variable class arrivals and enhancing CIL robustness in imbalanced scenarios.
